name: Payments API v4 Migration
description: Migrate the Payments API integration from processor v3 to v4 endpoints, implement circuit-breaker, and add contract tests. Addresses ADR-001, ADR-002.

name: Billing Reliability Hardening
description: Replace timestamp-based idempotency keys with UUID v7, add duplicate-charge detection, and implement billing reconciliation reports. Addresses ADR-003.

name: Certificate Lifecycle Automation
description: Deploy cert-expiry exporter, integrate alerts into PagerDuty, and harden the certificate rotation scripts with validation guards. Addresses ADR-005.

name: Analytics Query Governance
description: Enforce read-replica routing and statement timeouts for all analytical queries. Migrate long-running reports to the data warehouse. Addresses ADR-006.

name: SMS Multi-Provider Integration
description: Integrate Vonage as a secondary SMS provider and implement the priority router. Addresses ADR-008.

name: Canary Deployment Framework
description: Build the canary deployment pipeline for all Tier-1 services, including automated rollback on error rate threshold. Addresses ADR-007.
